title: SEC1: BASE_URL env var lookup duplicated in session_handler, not consolidated in Config
description:
In commit 08810bf, session_handler (lib.rs:59–66) reads KITHD_BASE_URL and deprecated KITH_BASE_URL directly on every request, bypassing the Config struct.

ISSUE: Config.from_env() loads most config at startup and stores in AppState (port, data_dir, owner_id, etc.), but base_url is NOT stored. Instead, every /.well-known/jmap request re-reads env vars.

BURDEN: Hidden coupling — future maintainers may not realize Config doesn't include base_url, and may incorrectly assume it's initialized once at startup like other settings. Two separate code paths warn about KITH_* deprecation (config.rs:137 and lib.rs:62), increasing cognitive load.

RECOMMENDATION: Move base_url into Config struct (already parsed at startup) and store in AppState. Session handler should read from AppState.config or AppState.base_url, not from environment.

FILES: crates/kithd/src/config.rs (add base_url parsing), crates/kithd/src/lib.rs (remove env var lookup from session_handler), crates/kithd/src/extractors.rs (if AppState modified)
